create.name: Buddhist Fellowship
create.bio:
Buddhist Fellowship (BF) is a non-sectarian Buddhist community in Singapore. Its practice leans towards the Theravada, yet it invites monks, nuns and lay speakers from every school, and it sees its role as a place where people of any age can learn the Dhamma, serve others and build spiritual friendships. It has recently settled into a new home, the BF DhammaHome on Lavender Street, and also runs a smaller venue, BF East, in Paya Lebar. Most of its retreats and teaching events are offered free, supported by donations.

The weekly Sunday service has been at the heart of the community since it began: a short chant and guided sit, then a long talk from a visiting monastic or lay teacher, and a shared potluck lunch. Through the year it runs Dhamma courses, from basic Buddhism to sutta study and the Heart Sutra, as well as meditation courses grounded in ethics, stillness and wisdom, day retreats, youth and children's classes, an Indonesian-language discussion group and community service. Talks and retreats are recorded for its YouTube channel, active since 2014 with close to nine hundred videos.

courses.title: Dhamma courses
courses.description: Courses held through the year by monastics and lay teachers, from an introduction to Buddhism to sutta appreciation, the Triple Gem and the Heart Sutra. Dates are announced on the fellowship's site and event pages.

courses.title: Meditation courses
courses.description: Regular courses teaching the basics of sitting practice, set within the Buddhist framework of ethics, stillness and wisdom. Led by experienced monastic or lay teachers.

free_resources.title: Weekly Sunday Service
free_resources.description: A Sunday morning gathering open to everyone: chanting and a short guided sit, a talk of about an hour and a half by a visiting speaker, then a potluck lunch. Many of the talks are later posted on the fellowship's YouTube channel.
